landing.promise: No locked features · No trial · Your data is never sold

free.a: Yes. No locked features, no trial and no paid plan. Everything on this page is yours from the day you sign up.

analytics.q: How do you count my visitors?
analytics.a: Without cookies, and with bots filtered out. You see how many came, from where and what they clicked, not who they are.

import.q: Can I move from another page?
import.a: Yes. Paste the address of your old page or your GitHub; we show what we found first and add nothing until you confirm.

domain.q: Can I use my own domain?
domain.a: Yes, for free. Add it in Settings and enter the DNS record we show at your provider; once verified, your page opens there.

rename.q: Will my old link break if I change my username?
rename.a: No. Your old address forwards to the new one for 30 days, so the links you shared keep working.

data.q: Where is my data, and who gets it?
data.a: Nobody. It is stored in Europe; no ads, no AI training, no sharing with third parties. Details in the <link>privacy notice</link>.
